about.summary: InSiamtion Research Group (IRG) is a student-led research organization founded by students of American International University-Bangladesh that builds a collaborative ecosystem for passionate and capable researchers.
goals: Unite bright, dedicated, and growth-oriented students
Mentor aspiring researchers and develop academic leaders
Create a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence within the AIUB community
Publish high-quality journal and conference papers

announcement.summary: Selection complete: we selected 10 members across 3 teams from 40+ candidates. Registration is now closed.
announcement.details: Our teams have started working and training sessions are ongoing on Discord: https://discord.gg/5UQXTqJy7

purpose.context: Many students have strong technical skills, innovative ideas, research interest, and academic potential but often lack a reliable research team, proper mentorship, collaborative opportunities, research workflow experience, and guidance for publication.
purpose.missionSummary: IRG exists to bridge that gap by building teams, mentoring students, and providing structured research opportunities.
aims: Develop real-world research and communication skills
Create opportunities for academic and professional growth

vision: To create one of the most impactful student-led research communities within AIUB that empowers talented students through mentorship, teamwork, and high-quality research contributions.
mission: Unite dedicated and talented AIUB students under a collaborative research platform
Mentor students who are interested in research and publication
Foster teamwork, innovation, and academic excellence
Produce impactful journal and conference publications
Help members grow technically, academically, and professionally
Establish a long-term research culture among students
organizationalPhilosophy: Great researchers are developed through mentorship and consistency
Every member should both learn and contribute
Discipline and teamwork are essential for impactful research
Growth matters as much as publication
membershipExpectations: Dedicate 6–10 hours weekly to research activities
Participate actively in discussions and meetings
Continuously improve research and technical skills

mentorshipCulture.summary: IRG is mentorship-driven: senior members and team leaders guide junior researchers, share resources, conduct learning sessions, and support newcomers.
expectationsForSeniors: Support newcomers in understanding the research process

featuredResearch.summary: IRG members are actively publishing conference papers across IEEE, Springer Nature, ACM Digital Library (ICCA), Atlantis Press, and leading conferences like ICCIT, ICECTE, QPAIN, IDAA, and more, while building toward future journal publications.
highlights: IEEE, Springer Nature, ACM Digital Library, and Atlantis Press venues
Top peer-reviewed conferences including ICCA, ICCIT, ICECTE, QPAIN, and IDAA

recruitment.summary: We are actively recruiting passionate students across all research teams. If you want to build real projects, publish conference research, and grow with a focused team, apply now.
recruitment.note: We are looking for committed members who want to contribute to research and publication work.

whyJoinUs.headline: Join a team built for capable students who want to make a real impact.
whyJoinUs.summary: We are a dedicated, growing research team focused on high-quality work, strong collaboration, and meaningful contribution. If you are skilled, motivated, and looking for a team that values dedication and action, this is where you belong.
points: Work with like-minded people who take research seriously
Contribute to a team that values dedication, discipline, and consistency
Get real support, feedback, and space to grow your strengths
Be part of a team where capable students can actually shine through contribution
whyJoinUs.closing: Many talented students never get to shine because they lack the right team support. We are building that team: one that contributes deeply, works with purpose, and grows together.

confidentialityPolicy: No unpublished work may be shared externally without authorization

authorshipPolicy.note: Fairness, transparency, and ethical publication standards will always be maintained

longTermGoals: Publish in reputed journals and conferences
Create a strong research culture within AIUB
Represent AIUB through impactful research contributions
Establish IRG as a respected student research community
